decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation builds directly on the firm's in-house laser expertise and established product family, so management can interpret early results and refine the models itself, and it makes sense to keep developing the line.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core coding portfolio and has its own web page, so the firm's existing knowledge of inks, integration and service lets it absorb market feedback and improve the product.

The piezo inkjet printer extends the firm's established inkjet competence toward Industry 4.0 traceability applications, and its own R&D gives management the capacity to learn from early results rather than withdraw it after one year.
